mechanism: Tadalafil may potentiate levodopa's vasodilatory effects and both drugs can lower blood pressure, increasing orthostatic hypotension risk; levodopa may cause dyskinesias that could be exacerbated by tadalafil's hemodynamic effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely in patients taking both agents; counsel on orthostatic hypotension precautions and potential dyskinesia changes; dose adjustment may be needed if hypotension develops.
